name: Kazki
source:
Kazki is a Tir Qou Obesk who worked in the Embassy in the Call Research Initiative alongside Akizet.

She worked on the "Kozazni excavation" while she was larval. Her room was in the same arm as Miltza. She has a large collection of firearms in her room. 

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Kazki]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
